LESSON: DIVERSITY AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 3.5: Diversity and interpersonal skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Diversity and interpersonal skills
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can we demonstrate respect and appreciation of social cultural diversity and inclusion?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain ways of building a healthy self- esteem in diverse social cultural society
2. describe the impact of emotions on self and others
3. appreciate social cultural diversities in Kenya
